title: Houston Distillery Tour with 4 Spirit Tastings
includes: Distilling process overview and Introduction to William Price Distilling
Bottles, merchandise, and retail items are available for purchase separately (not included)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Discover the art of distilling at William Price Distilling in Houston with a guided tour that provides a behind-the-scenes look at the spirit-making process. Enjoy a tasting flight featuring four of their unique in-house spirits, including whiskey and vodka. This engaging experience is perfect for whiskey enthusiasts, couples, groups, and anyone looking for a memorable outing in Houston. Guests will have access to the production area, barrel room, and tasting room while learning about the distillation process from knowledgeable guides.

- Guided distillery tour with production insights
- Tasting flight of four in-house spirits included
- Available multiple days a week at 6 PM, and 3pm on weekends
- Private tours for groups of 6+ can be arranged upon request
